image_description: A pelican in flight against a clear blue sky. The bird is captured from a side profile, wings fully extended upwards. It features brownish-grey plumage on the body and darker brown flight feathers. The head has a yellowish crown and a long, prominent bill with a visible gular pouch.

The area where the legs should tuck into the body is indistinct and muddy. While pelicans tuck legs, the geometry here lacks clear definition of the limb structure, appearing slightly fused with the belly feathers.
